headline: SIGN AFTER CHANGES: 10 critical issues must be resolved before signing
nextAction: AtliQ counsel must revise the draft terms and Karandeep must resolve the dependency on Rheinwerk.

findings.title: Missing mandatory data protection flow-down
findings.impact: AtliQ is in conflict with Section 13.1 of the Rheinwerk contract which mandates a Data Processing Agreement for any sub-processing.

citations.docTitle: Kriti Data Labs subcontractor agreement (AtliQ draft)
citations.quote: Source data comprises … technician names, shift identifiers and free-text notes
the Parties shall conclude the Data Processing Agreement pursuant to Art. 28 GDPR attached as **Annex 3

findings.standard: DPA (EU) or BAA (US health) signed before any personal/regulated data moves, with a sub-DPA / sub-BAA for every party that touches the data (incl. AtliQ's own Pune entity); engagement-specific scope; offshore access only as the agreement allows.
findings.counterPosition: Execute the DPA/BAA and the sub-agreements first; ensure personnel are bound by data secrecy.

precedents.label: standard
precedents.note: Counsel-reviewed: capped liability, 5-day reporting, de-identified offshore route

findings.title: Indemnity covers AtliQ's own negligence
findings.impact: Vendor could be held liable for losses that were actually caused by AtliQ's faults or omissions.

citations.docTitle: Kriti Data Labs subcontractor agreement (AtliQ draft)
citations.quote: Vendor shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless AtliQ … from and against any and all Losses … regardless of whether such Losses are caused in whole or in part by the negligence of any AtliQ Indemnitee
Each Party shall indemnify the other against third-party claims resulting from its culpable breach of this Agreement

findings.standard: Mutual: each party covers its own breach and negligence; never the other side's negligence. IP-infringement indemnity for deliverables is normal.
findings.counterPosition: Each party indemnifies the other for third-party claims caused by its own conflict or negligence; no indemnity for losses caused by the indemnified party's own negligence.

Supplier shall be entitled to the agreed remuneration for services rendered plus compensation for committed costs

findings.standard: On any termination for convenience AtliQ is paid for all work done, including work in progress. Notice is mutual. Client contracts: reasonable notice (typically 30+ days). Freelancer / vendor agreements: a mutual short exit (about 15 days, as with Rohan Iyer) is AtliQ's standard and fair to both sides.
findings.counterPosition: Payment for all services performed up to termination, including work in progress and committed costs.

findings.impact: AtliQ risks being in conflict with the main agreement if it engages Kriti before obtaining Rheinwerk's formal approval.

findings.standard: Apply the same standard AtliQ asks for as a supplier: capped penalties or none, 30-day pay, mutual caps, no pay-when-paid, fair termination. Pass the client's obligations down (IP, confidentiality, data protection, consent), never the client's leverage.
findings.counterPosition: Ensure AtliQ obtains and documents Rheinwerk's consent before Vendor commences work.

findings.title: No deemed acceptance mechanism
findings.impact: AtliQ could indefinitely delay payment by failing to formally accept a deliverable, creating a risk AtliQ would not accept from a client.

citations.docTitle: Kriti Data Labs subcontractor agreement (AtliQ draft)
citations.quote: Acceptance shall not be deemed to occur by … the passage of time
If Client fails to declare acceptance or to specify material defects within the period … acceptance shall be deemed to have been granted

findings.standard: The clause explicitly excludes acceptance by the passage of time, whereas the client contract allows for deemed acceptance.
findings.counterPosition: Include a deemed acceptance clause (e.g., 10 business days if no material defects are notified).

findings.title: Non-mutual confidentiality definition
findings.impact: Vendor's own confidential information or trade secrets (like their labeling platform details) are not protected under this agreement.

citations.docTitle: Kriti Data Labs subcontractor agreement (AtliQ draft)
citations.quote: Confidential Information**" means all non-public information disclosed by or on behalf of AtliQ or the End Client
The Parties shall keep confidential all business and trade secrets of the other Party

findings.standard: Mutual in substance, not just in title: both parties' information protected, both bound by the same obligations, residuals mutual or none, mutual remedies, fixed term, and no non-competes or non-solicits hidden inside an NDA.
findings.counterPosition: Make the definitions and obligations mutual.

15.2 Disputes not resolved by negotiation between senior management within thirty (30) days shall be referred to arbitration by a sole arbitrator under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996. The seat and venue of arbitration shall be Pune, and the language shall be English.

hits.heading: GOVERNING LAW AND DISPUTE RESOLUTION
hits.label: concession
hits.text:
15.1 This Agreement is governed by the laws of the Republic of Singapore.

15.2 The Parties shall first attempt to resolve any dispute through good-faith discussions between senior executives for thirty (30) days.

15.3 Any dispute not so resolved shall be referred to and finally resolved by arbitration administered by the Singapore International Arbitration Centre ("**SIAC**") under the SIAC Rules in force at the time. The seat of arbitration shall be Singapore. The tribunal shall consist of one (1) arbitrator. The language of arbitration shall be English.

21.1 This Agreement and any non-contractual obligations arising out of it shall be governed by the laws of the Dubai International Financial Centre.

21.2 The Parties shall first attempt to resolve any dispute through good-faith negotiation between senior executives for thirty (30) days.

21.3 Failing resolution, the courts of the Dubai International Financial Centre shall have exclusive jurisdiction.
